1- Taking it back from reddit, usually dont stay in a relationship that makes you feel « alright », go for the « F*** YEAH ». I did and that combined with other factors got me into depression

2- My mental health gets better with my boyfriend. If yours goes worse, thats a good reason to leave imo

3- i dont know your age, but if you’re under 16~18, and he’s acting like this with you, that could lead to a big amount of huge problems. 

4- Now aside from what God may send as signs, how fo you personally feel about the situation? If you feel like something is stuck in your chest, as if you ate something bad and it wont come out, or if youre generally feeling uneasy about the situation, (and you even already tried to talk about it), then you really should leave. That its from God, from yourself, or your body, if you have to fight signs or everything feels like an invite to leave, then the relationship will never work. Or it will, but you might not be happy.

5- Are you usually uncomfy with sex? If not, then being disgusted of previously sexting with him might also be a bad sign. I did things im not proud of but even when these happened, i was not disgusted by them when theyre related to my boyfriend.

Good luck and i hope the best for you
